name: @studio/k7-wasm
description: The browser's one WebAssembly module: Rust (song-schema, the song crate's decoders and views, k7x) behind a C ABI carrying JSON, its TypeScript loader, and its generated types and constants. The module is the checked-in file src/k7Wasm.wasm: a page fetches it as a hashed asset, node reads it from disk. Consumed as source.
